newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberdrola 9-mo net profit rises 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Iberdrola 9-mo net profit rises 20 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish electrical group Iberdrola in nine months to end September in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE - Iberdrola said financial expenses narrowed 19.6 percent, as the group's debt level fell. Average debt cost fell to 8.19 percent in 1996 from 8.37 percent in 1995.
Total debt was cut by 611 billion pesetas by the end of the third quarter.
Funds generated from operations reached 235 billion pesetas with year-on-year growth of 9.7 percent.

Investments in fixed assets totalled 53 billion pesetas, of which 31 percent were in generation, 48 percent to modernising and enlarging distribution installations and 21 percent in nuclear power and other fixed assets.
